desc: Rewrite `generateString` with the greedy (T-force all windows; leftover cells → 'a' and marked free; scan 'F' windows left to right; break each still-matching window via its rightmost free cell).
Run the differential tester: EXACT verdict "NO MISMATCHES across 6198 cases"; statement examples verified (`TFTF/ab→'ababa'`, `TFTF/abc→''`, `F/d→'a'`).
Edge cases (m=1, all-T consistent/conflicting, all-F, str2='a'/'b') verified consistent with exhaustive search.

Correctness argument confirmed: a flip to 'b' at a free cell turns a matching window's 'a' into 'b' (≠ str2's 'a'), and since broken cells become permanently fixed, already-broken windows stay broken; overlapping matching windows share 'a' at free cells so one flip breaks both; a fully-forced matching F window ⇒ genuinely impossible.
Alphabet assumption validated: brute over set(str2)|{a,b} equals brute with an extra letter on all small cases.
Complexity check: O(n·m) time (≤ ~10^7) and O(n+m) space, within limits for n≤10^4, m≤500.
